title: Technician Bench Note — Fork and Bearing Inspection on Repeat Caster Work, Mobility Equipment
content:
# Repeat Caster Work and the Caster Allowance — Mobility Equipment

**Bench rule.** When a tire or caster replacement under the manufacturer's warranty is already posted on a Mobility Equipment chair, the caster allowance claimed from the manufacturer for a further warranty caster replacement is set by how long before the day the caster claim is posted the latest such posting lies: no more than 30 days before, the caster allowance is the standard caster allowance doubled, to pay for a fork and bearing inspection; more than 30 but no more than 180 days before, it is the standard caster allowance plus one unit; with no such posting, or an older one, the standard caster allowance applies unchanged.

## The earlier posting

A repair job in the chair's service history with the tires and casters as the component repaired and the manufacturer's warranty as the party bearing the cost. The latest such job by job date is the one measured.

## Tiers

| Latest warranty tire or caster job, days before the posting day | Caster allowance |
|---|---|
| 30 or fewer | the standard caster allowance doubled |
| 31 to 180 | the standard caster allowance plus one unit |
| more than 180, or none | the standard caster allowance, unchanged |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Latest warranty caster job on 2 March, new claim posted 1 April: 30 days, doubled.
- Same job, claim posted 2 April: 31 days, plus one unit.
- A caster repair earlier paid by the patient is not a warranty posting and is not measured.
